findings.title: NVD record for CVE-2025-5777 (Citrix NetScaler ADC and Gateway)
findings.summary_md: The CVE record was published on 2025-06-17 and describes insufficient input validation leading to memory overread when NetScaler is configured as a Gateway (VPN virtual server, ICA Proxy, CVPN, RDP Proxy) or AAA virtual server. NVD scores it 7.5 with the vector AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N. Date taken from the NVD API record.

findings.title: NetScaler Critical Security Updates for CVE-2025-6543 and CVE-2025-5777
findings.summary_md: The vendor blog (dated June 26, 2025 on the page) states the Citrix security bulletin CTX693420 for CVE-2025-5777 was published on June 17, 2025, rates the flaw CVSS 9.3, and says there are no mitigations and no WAF signatures, only fixed builds. It instructs admins to run the kill sessions commands after upgrading for CVE-2025-5777, notes 12.0/13.0 builds are EOL with no fixes, and points to recovery runbook CTX694799 and NetScaler Console file integrity monitoring. It also records that CISA added the CVE to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog on July 10, 2025, after Citrix initially saw no exploitation evidence at disclosure.

findings.title: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities Catalog: CVE-2025-5777
findings.summary_md: The KEV feed shows CVE-2025-5777 was added on 2025-07-10 with a due date of 2025-07-11 and the flag knownRansomwareCampaignUse: Known. The entry describes an out-of-bounds read (CWE-125) in NetScaler ADC and Gateway and cites the vendor advisory CTX693420. Date taken from the CISA KEV JSON feed.

findings.title: Exclusive: Ransomware attack against Copec: Anubis claims exfiltration of 6 TB of data
findings.summary_md: SuspectFile's January 9, 2026 exclusive on Anubis's claimed attack against Empresas Copec S.A., the Chilean energy and fuels holding, with the group claiming 6 TB of exfiltrated data. A January 9 update notes Copec said it contained the attack and that customer data were not compromised, without addressing the exfiltration claims. Publication time from the article's own metadata (11:10:00+01:00).

findings.title: Brockton Hospital cyberattack: Anubis names victim publicly and launches countdown, new details emerge
findings.summary_md: SuspectFile reported on April 9, 2026 that Anubis claimed the attack on Brockton Hospital, the core facility of the Signature Healthcare network in Massachusetts, and publicly named the victim with a countdown after contacting SuspectFile directly. The group stated the attack was carried out by a team of professionals and that only non-critical systems were encrypted. Publication time from the article's own metadata (22:46:54+02:00).
